description: This file defines the Addition class within the Matrix\Operators namespace, implementing addition operations for matrices and scalar values, with methods for execution, validation, and element-wise addition.

classes.name: Addition
classes.description: A class that provides addition operations for matrices and scalar values, supporting chaining and validation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs addition of a matrix or scalar to the current matrix, returning the instance for chaining.

methods.name: addScalar
methods.description: Adds a scalar value to every element of the matrix.

methods.name: addMatrix
methods.description: Adds another matrix to the current matrix after validating dimensions.
